use_cases.title: 1-Second 'Anti-Loop' Weight Hotfix for Local Reasoning LLMs
use_cases.industry: Edge AI / Local Coding & Math Copilots (Qwen3.5-0.8B)
use_cases.problem: Small open-weight reasoning models frequently get trapped repeating 'Wait, let me re-evaluate...' until they hit the 8,192-token limit. Full fine-tuning (RLHF/SFT) takes hours of GPU compute and often breaks formatting.
use_cases.solution: Trace backward from the repetition token to find the exact 64 MLP columns in Layers 15 & 19 feeding the loop vector, then project out that 1D direction in <1 second.

MATH-500.meaning: Competition math problems solved without getting trapped in infinite CoT loops

GSM8K.meaning: Grade-school multi-step word problems completed cleanly

use_cases.before_trace: Wait, let me re-check step 2... Wait, let me re-verify step 2... [Repeats 48x -> Hits 8,192 token ceiling]
use_cases.after_trace: Step 2 verified: 3x + 5 = 20 => x = 5. Final Answer: \boxed{5} (Completed in 184 tokens)

use_cases.title: Surgical Safety Reflex Injection for Autonomous & RL Controllers
use_cases.industry: Robotics / Autonomous Vehicles / Game AI (Kinetix PPO)
use_cases.problem: A trained RL agent drives forward into a steep ramp and stalls forever (0% goal reach) because standard reward shaping penalized moving backward. Retraining from scratch takes millions of environment steps and changes behavior across already-working scenarios.
use_cases.solution: Graft a 6-neuron backward-inducted threshold subgame into dormant hidden units (3.5% of weights) that activates ONLY when forward velocity stalls (< 0.14), reverses to build momentum, and cancels to exact 0.000000 during normal driving.

summary_metrics.edited_outcome: BACKED UP TO WALL -> LAUNCHED OVER RAMP -> REACHED GOAL (100%)
